questions.question: What is the colour of the ‘perfect’ crema.
What are three (3) possible causes that may produce crema that is paler than required?
guidance: Temperature of water not hot enough
answer_points: Temperature of water not hot enough

questions.question: Provide three (3) possible causes why the flow rate from the espresso machine may decrease.
guidance: Dose too tightly packed or tamped too hard
Obstruction in or problem with water flow
answer_points: Dose too tightly packed or tamped too hard
Obstruction in or problem with water flow

answer_points: Firm and little spongy – not loose and wet, and not hard as rock
